subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: Should valid under-4-MiB ignore files that exceed the new internal pattern-count or pattern-length limits be terminally excluded from workspace discovery?
rationale: The limits prevent matcher amplification, but terminally excluding a valid existing ignore policy changes discovery semantics and cannot be chosen safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Preserve valid ignore semantics
options.body: Keep the bounded byte read and redesign or relax complexity handling so valid under-cap ignore policies do not silently hide their subtree.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed complexity limits
options.body: Accept terminal subtree exclusion for valid but complex ignore policies and document the compatibility contract plus upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve valid ignore semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded byte read and redesign or relax complexity handling so valid under-cap ignore policies do not silently hide their subtree.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent scan-policy commits and assignment show the strongest available ownership signal for this contract choice.
